rule_outs: Dwelling 6 m from the best section
summary: Short residential kerb with houses 4-6 m from it.
reasons: Detached houses 4 m and 6 m away

drivers.seclusion: Rail corridor to the north, but a house sits about 6 m from the kerb and more across the street.
drivers.access_and_room: Two cars park on the street beyond the section; the kerb is narrow and the section is shorter than a van length of clear room.
drivers.traffic: Quiet end of a residential street by a junction and rail line.
drivers.convention: Mapped parking:both no, and a Mon-Fri 7am-6pm no-parking sign.

flags: Steep: about 4.5% average, up to 7% grade
Building site opposite in QLD image, gone in Esri
sun_shade: Open to the north over the rail corridor; trees shade the east side.

best_section.where: Kerb where Adsett St meets the road beside the rail line
